pwa.title: Install PantryLens on your device
pwa.ios: Tap the Share button ↑ then "Add to Home Screen" for quick access.
pwa.android: Tap the browser menu (⋮) then "Add to Home screen" for quick access.

home.step1Desc: Take up to 3 photos of your fridge, freezer, or pantry.
home.step2Desc: Our AI identifies every visible ingredient in your photos.
home.step3Desc: Receive a complete recipe using only what you have.
home.why1: Reduce food waste — cook what you have before it expires
home.why2: Instant results — recipe streams to you in seconds, token by token
home.why3: Completely free — no account, no subscription, no hidden limits
home.why4: Works on any device — installable as a PWA on iOS and Android
home.why5: Powered by Gemma 4 — Google's latest vision AI model
home.use1Desc: Before grocery shopping or a trip, cook what's left
home.use2Desc: Turn random leftovers into something delicious
home.use3Desc: Discover recipes from canned goods and dry staples
home.use4Desc: No recipe ideas? Just snap and cook.
home.faq1A: PantryLens can identify most common fruits, vegetables, proteins, dairy products, condiments, and pantry staples visible in your photo. Clear, well-lit photos give the best results.
home.faq2Q: How many photos can I upload at once?
home.faq2A: You can upload up to 3 photos per request — for example, one of your fridge, one of your freezer, and one of your pantry shelves.
home.faq3A: Yes. PantryLens is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Use it in any mobile browser or install it to your home screen for a native app experience on both iOS and Android.
home.faq4A: Yes — PantryLens is completely free with no account, subscription, or hidden fees required.
home.faq5Q: Can I use PantryLens with unusual or limited ingredients?
home.faq5A: Absolutely. PantryLens is designed to work creatively with whatever you have — even sparse or unusual combinations. It will always suggest the most practical recipe possible.
home.faq6A: No. Photos are compressed locally on your device and sent directly to the AI for analysis. Neither your photos nor the generated recipes are stored by PantryLens.
home.footerTagline: PantryLens — AI Recipe Generator from Fridge Photos
home.footerSub: Free to use · No account required · Works on any device
